feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day shipping forecast

items.title: 5 day shipping forecast updated as of 20 October 2026 5:41am
items.description:
##Yesterday##


##Warnings)##

Nil.


##Wind)##

SE 3 to 5, becoming S or SE this afternoon, then becoming variable 3 or less overnight.


##State of sea)##

Slight becoming slight or moderate later.


##Weather)##

Outbreaks of rain soon, clearing early tonight.


##Visibility)##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 10°C and max. air temperature 14°C
##Sea Temperature##

15°C
##Today##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds.


##Wind)##

Variable 2 to 4 soon becoming W or NW 5 to 7 through the morning. Gradually decreasing W 4 to 6 late afternoon, then 3 or 4 later.


##State of sea)##

Slight becoming mainly moderate for a time.


##Weather)##

Outbreaks of rain clearing to showers in the afternoon, then mainly fair overnight.


##Visibility)##

Moderate or poor in rain becoming mostly good in the afternoon, occasionally moderate in any showers.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 10°C and max. air temperature 13°C
##Sea Temperature##

15°C
##Tomorrow##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds to gale force winds developing later.


##Wind)##

W or SW 3 or 4, backing SE in the afternoon, then increasing E or SE 5 or 6 in the evening. Further increasing E or NE 6 or 7 overnight, then N or NW 7 or gale 8 later.


##State of sea)##

Slight building moderate or rough later.


##Weather)##

Fair, then heavy rain overnight.


##Visibility)##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain later.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 10°C and max. air temperature 13°C
##Sea Temperature##

15°C
##Friday, 23 October 2026##


##Warnings)##

Gales or Severe Gales.


##Wind)##

W or NW 7 or Gale 8, occasionally Severe Gale 9, decreasing 6 or 7 overnight.


##State of sea)##

Moderate or rough soon becoming rough or very rough for a time.


##Weather)##

Rain clearing to showers later.


##Visibility)##

Moderate or poor becoming moderate or good.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 9°C and max. air temperature 12°C
##Sea Temperature##

14°C
##Saturday, 24 October 2026##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds.


##Wind)##

NW 6 or 7, decreasing W or NW 4 or 5, backing SW in the afternoon, then increasing S 5 or 6, occasionally 7 in the evening. Veering W or SW later.


##State of sea)##

Mainly moderate, occasionally rough at first.


##Weather)##

Fair at first, then rain arriving in the afternoon.


##Visibility)##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain later.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 7°C and max. air temperature 13°C
##Sea Temperature##

14°C
